authorization: Supplied by the user to replace the remaining Figma loading/progress artwork.
licenseNote: User-provided artwork; no separate asset license is asserted here. Historical design attribution remains in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
layout: Vertical strip of square frames, no gaps
method: Copied byte-for-byte without cropping, resizing, recoloring or interpolation. All frames share one fixed canvas/center during rendering.

animations.name: loading
animations.behavior: Repeating 16-frame cycle; 9 ring pixels per frame

animations.name: progress
animations.behavior: Frames contain 1 through 16 ring pixels; 0% draws no frame, positive progress uses ceil(progress * 16) - 1
